spans.s:
pṛṣadājya
(‘speckled ghee’)
------------------------------------------
In Paśuyāgas (animal sacrifices) the पृषदाज्य is an important ingredient that is used to sprinkle over the heart of the animal immolated. It is actually a mixture of आज्य or ghee sprinkled with curdled milk.
The details of its preparation and use are generally dealt with in the Śrauta-sūtras (vide आपस्तम्ब Śrautasūtras 7.23.7; Baudhāyana Śrautasūtras 4.3).
